title: Pack manifest
description: `pack.yaml`: identifies a content pack and declares its version, license, credit line and other license notices, dependencies, minimum spec version and default language. The pack's display name is the translation key `pack.name`.

id.description: `homebrew` is reserved for a character's own homebrew.

version.description: This pack's version. Every update gets a unique version; published versions never change.

specVersion.description: The minimum OCF spec version this pack needs. loadRuleset refuses a pack that needs a newer spec.

license.description: An SPDX license identifier (`CC-BY-4.0`, `CC0-1.0`), `ORC`, `OGL-1.0a` (the Open Game License v1.0a, which has no SPDX identifier), or `mechanics-only` for packs that carry no copyrighted text.

credit.description: The credit line (attribution) the license requires. Required for CC-BY and ORC licenses; must reach downstream users.

notices.description: Other legal notices the license requires besides `credit`, by name, in the order written. Legal text, shown verbatim and not translated; must reach downstream users after `credit`. An `ORC` pack must have `orc` (the ORC Notice), `reserved-material` and `expressly-designated` (the Expressly Designated Licensed Material notice); an `OGL-1.0a` pack must have `ogl-license` (the license's full text) and `section-15` (its COPYRIGHT NOTICE); other names may follow.

dependencies.description: Packs this pack builds on, by pack ID and version range.

hides.description: Homebrew: content from dependencies to hide from this ruleset.
